question: Aunt Gloria walked out of her house and walked 65 m towards the east. She took a left turn and walked 28 m. Again, she took a left turn and walked 110 m to reach a public library. How far (shortest distance) and in which direction is the library from Aunt Gloria’s house?
options:
48 m, North-East

48 m, North-West

53 m, North-East

53 m, North-West
solution:
The correct answer is option 4 i.e. 53 m, North-West

The given diagram shows the correct path towards the library:

Using Pythagoras Theorm:

(Hypotenuse)2 = (Perpendicular)2 + (Base)2

The shortest distance between House and the library will be :

(45)2 + (28)2 = √(2025 + 784) = √2809 = 53m
question_hi: आंटी ग्लोरिया अपने घर से बाहर निकलीं और पूर्व की ओर 65 मीटर चलीं। वह बाएं मुड़ी और 28 मीटर चली। फिर, वह बाएं मुड़ी और सार्वजनिक पुस्तकालय तक पहुंचने के लिए 110 मीटर चली। आंटी ग्लोरिया के घर से पुस्तकालय कितनी दूर (न्यूनतम दूरी) और किस दिशा में है?
options_hi:
48 मीटर, उत्तर-पूर्व

48 मीटर, उत्तर-पश्चिम

53 मीटर, उत्तर-पूर्व

53 मीटर, उत्तर-पश्चिम
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 अर्थात् 53 मीटर, उत्तर-पश्चिम है

दिया गया चित्र पुस्तकालय की ओर सही मार्ग दिखाता है:

पाइथागोरस प्रमेय का उपयोग करने पर:

(कर्ण)2 = (लंब)2 + (आधार)2

घर और पुस्तकालय के बीच न्यूनतम दूरी होगी:

(45)2 + (28)2 = 2025 + 784 = √2809 = 53 मीटर

question: A woman walked 7 km towards the East, took a right turn and walked 3 km, took another right turn and walked 3 km. She then walked 8 km towards the North turned right and walked 14 km. She then finally took a right turn and walked 5 km. How far is she from the starting point?

The correct answer is option 4 i.e. 18 km  

From the figure;

DC = BO (3 km)

AB = AO - BO = (7 - 3) = 4km

BG = EF = 14 km

OG = (EF - BO) = (14 - 3) = 11km

AG = AB + BO + OG = (4 + 3 + 11) = 18km

From the figure, she is 18km from the starting point.

solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 अर्थात् 18 किमी है

आकृति से;

AB = AO - BO = (7 - 3) = 4 किमी

BG = EF = 14 किमी

OG = (EF - BO) = (14 - 3) = 11किमी

AG = AB + BO + OG = (4 + 3 + 11) = 18 किमी

आकृति के अनुसार, वह प्रारंभिक बिंदु से 18 किमी दूर है।

question: Stanley starts cycling from Point A. He cycles X km towards the west and then turns right and cycles 3 km. He again turns right and cycles for X+1 km. The correct answer is option 3 i.e. 4

solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 अर्थात् 4 है

RS = RT + TS

2x + 1 = PQ + AB

2x + 1 = 3 + 6

2x + 1 = 9

x = 4

चित्र से, x का मान = 4

question: A man walks 8km towards the West; takes a right turn and walks 6km. He then walks 5km towards the starting point and reaches the destination. How far is he from the starting position?
solution:
The correct answer is option 4 i.e. 5km

⇒ (5+x)2 = 62 + 82

⇒ (5+x)2 = 36 + 64

⇒ (5+x)2 = 100

⇒ 5 + x = 10

⇒ x = 5

He is 5km far from the starting position.

Hence, the correct answer is 5km.

5 + x = 10

x = 5

वह प्रारंभिक स्थिति से 5 किमी दूर है।

अतः, सही उत्तर 5 किमी है।
